summary: Raven is an open‑source modular harness framework for building robotic systems integration (RSI) applications, provided as both a CLI tool and a Python library. It runs locally without any API keys and is distributed via PyPI (v6.10.0). Developers of robotics pipelines looking for reusable orchestration components will find it useful, especially given its active community of 4,575 stars and recent commits. Its strongest point is the quick installation and full test pass, while the main drawback is limited documentation and lack of performance comparisons.
